full.description: This image is a low-power photomicrograph of a colon tissue section stained with hematoxylin and eosin. It displays a polypoid mucosal lesion projecting into the lumen from the colonic wall. The lesion consists of crowded, dysplastic epithelial glands, characteristic of a colon adenomatous polyp. The underlying submucosa and muscularis propria layers are also visible below the polyp.

random.description: This is a low-power photomicrograph of a gastrointestinal mucosal polyp, most likely a tubular adenoma. The H&E stained section shows a well-circumscribed, exophytic polypoid lesion composed of crowded, dysplastic mucosal glands extending from the mucosal surface. The underlying submucosa and muscularis propria layers of the intestinal wall are visible at the base. There is no evidence of invasive malignancy within the stalk or the surrounding tissue in this plane of section.
